resources.string: An extra to your white cane. Not a replacement. Works fully offline.
Hold the phone upright. The rear camera faces the way you walk.
Practice indoors with a helper first. This app misses steps, holes, poles, and many other obstacles. Keep using your cane.
Allow the camera so obstacle warnings can start
Open phone settings to allow the camera
Ready. Tap the big button to start.
The camera is off. Tap the big button and allow the camera. Photos are not saved.
Camera permission was not allowed. Obstacle Guide cannot warn you without the camera.
Camera permission is blocked. Open settings, then Permissions, and turn the camera on.
The detection model could not be loaded. Close the app and open it again.
No text-to-speech voice is installed on this phone. Turn on TalkBack or install a voice in text-to-speech settings.
Battery settings could not be opened on this phone.
Your phone will ask to use the camera. Please allow it. Obstacle Guide does not save photos and does not use the internet.
Battery saver is off. Double tap to turn it on.
Battery saver is on. Double tap to turn it off.
Vibration is off. Double tap to turn it on.
Vibration is on. Double tap to turn it off.
Keep running with the screen off
Open phone settings so Obstacle Guide can keep running when the screen is off
This phone allows Obstacle Guide to keep running with the screen off.
This phone may stop the app when the screen is off. Tap the button below and allow unrestricted battery use.
The English voice is not installed. Install a text-to-speech voice in phone settings.
The Hindi voice is not installed on this phone. Install the Hindi offline voice in the phone text-to-speech settings, or choose English. Until then, warnings are spoken in English.
The Tamil voice is not installed on this phone. Install the Tamil offline voice in the phone text-to-speech settings, or choose English. Until then, warnings are spoken in English.
The Bengali voice is not installed on this phone. Install the Bengali offline voice in the phone text-to-speech settings, or choose English. Until then, warnings are spoken in English.
The Swahili voice is not installed on this phone. Install the Swahili offline voice in the phone text-to-speech settings, or choose English. Until then, warnings are spoken in English.
The Spanish voice is not installed on this phone. Install the Spanish offline voice in the phone text-to-speech settings, or choose English. Until then, warnings are spoken in English.
